key.text: An engraved acrylic sign with my club's name for our tabling booth, about 12 inches wide. We need one.

output.summary: An engraved acrylic sign for a club tabling booth.

needs.why: To cut and engrave the acrylic sheet.

routes.process: Cut and engrave an acrylic sheet using a laser cutter (cuts flat sheets very precisely).
routes.fit_reason: The laser cutter handles acrylic sheets easily and creates clean engraved text.

steps.title: Design the sign
steps.detail: Draw your club name using design software.

steps.title: Take training
steps.detail: Complete the required safety training for the laser cutter (cuts flat sheets very precisely).

steps.title: Ask staff to check
steps.detail: Have staff review your digital file before cutting.

steps.title: Make the sign
steps.detail: Use the laser cutter (cuts flat sheets very precisely) to cut and engrave your acrylic sheet.

warnings.issue: Fine text may be hard to read on clear acrylic.
warnings.fix: Use a bold font for your club name.
